{"script":"mkdir -p temp_var_count
find /var -printf '%p|%y|%s|%TY-%Tm-%Td %TH:%TM:%.2TS|%M|%u|%g\n' > temp_var_count/var_snapshot.txt
awk -F'|' '$2=="f"{print $1}' temp_var_count/var_snapshot.txt > temp_var_count/file_paths.txt
while IFS= read -r f; do dirname "$f"; done < temp_var_count/file_paths.txt | sort | uniq -c | awk '{print $2 "," $1}' > temp_var_count/per_dir_counts.csv
sum=$(awk -F, '{s+=$2} END{print s+0}' temp_var_count/per_dir_counts.csv)
lines=$(wc -l < temp_var_count/file_paths.txt)
if [ "$sum" -ne "$lines" ]; then
  echo "Mismatch: sum of per-dir counts=$sum != file_paths_lines=$lines" > temp_var_count/anomalies.log
else
  echo "No anomalies: sums match" > temp_var_count/anomalies.log
fi
{
  echo "per_dir_counts_file: temp_var_count/per_dir_counts.csv"
  echo "file_paths_file: temp_var_count/file_paths.txt"
  echo "anomalies_log: temp_var_count/anomalies.log"
  echo "total_files:$lines"
  if [ "$sum" -ne "$lines" ]; then
    echo "status: mismatch"
  else
    echo "status: ok"
  fi
} > temp_var_count/ready_for_total.txt
echo "TOTAL_FILES:$lines""}
